engine.name: DiArt Color Engine
engine.scope: 12-season personal color analysis from a single portrait photo
engine.decision_principle: GPT extracts observable appearance features; the engine scores and selects the season.

confusion_resolution.purpose: Resolve close results between commonly confused neighboring seasons after base scoring and exclusion rules have been applied.

evidence_for_a.reason: Light Spring requires a warm or neutral-warm direction.
Golden or peach undertone supports Light Spring.
Light Spring is fresher and clearer.
Warm eye details support Light Spring.

evidence_for_b.reason: Light Summer requires a cool or neutral-cool direction.
Cool pink or neutral-cool skin supports Light Summer.
Light Summer is softer and more blended.
Cool gray veil supports Light Summer.

evidence_for_a.reason: True Spring is more purely warm.
True Spring is clear but not necessarily extreme.
True Spring usually has medium contrast.

evidence_for_b.reason: Bright Spring is defined by brightness.
Higher contrast supports Bright Spring.
Bright Spring may lean less purely warm than True Spring.
Sharp feature definition supports Bright Spring.

evidence_for_a.reason: Soft Summer is the cool-neutral Soft season.
Ash or smoky hair supports Soft Summer.
Cool or neutral-cool skin supports Soft Summer.

evidence_for_b.reason: Soft Autumn is the warm-neutral Soft season.
Warm muted hair supports Soft Autumn.
Warm or olive skin supports Soft Autumn.

evidence_for_a.reason: True Summer is softer and less contrasted.
Softness strongly supports True Summer.
Blended feature definition supports True Summer.

evidence_for_b.reason: True Winter requires strong contrast.
Clear chroma supports True Winter.
Sharp definition supports True Winter.
Depth supports True Winter over True Summer.

evidence_for_a.reason: Bright Spring is the warm Bright season.
Warm skin supports Bright Spring.
Warm hair supports Bright Spring.

evidence_for_b.reason: Bright Winter is the cool Bright season.
Cool skin supports Bright Winter.
Cool hair supports Bright Winter.

evidence_for_a.reason: Deep Autumn is the warm Deep season.
Warm depth supports Deep Autumn.
Warm or olive skin supports Deep Autumn.
Slightly softened depth supports Deep Autumn.

evidence_for_b.reason: Deep Winter is the cool Deep season.
Cool depth supports Deep Winter.
Cool or neutral-cool skin supports Deep Winter.
Cleaner depth supports Deep Winter.

generic_neighbor_rule.method: Compare candidates across temperature, value, chroma, and contrast. Use the dimension with the largest profile difference as the primary tie-breaker.

temperature_engine.purpose: Estimate warm/cool direction from observable facial features before season scoring. The module does not assign a season by itself.

evidence_priority.reason: Primary evidence when lighting and white balance are acceptable.
Useful secondary evidence when natural lip color is visible.
Useful as supporting evidence, not decisive by itself.
Use only when hair appears natural or likely natural.
Low-weight supporting evidence.

global_rules.unknown_handling: Ignore unknown fields and renormalize available source weights.
global_rules.conflict_handling: If warm and cool evidence differ by less than 10 points, classify as neutral or uncertain depending on total confidence.

eyes_rules.base_color_note: Base eye color must not determine temperature alone. Blue eyes can be warm-neutral; brown eyes can be cool-neutral.

value_engine.purpose: Estimate the overall lightness/depth of appearance from observable skin, natural hair, eyes, and feature contrast before season scoring.

evidence_priority.reason: Stable primary evidence when exposure and skin visibility are acceptable.
Strong evidence only when hair is natural or likely natural.
Supporting evidence for overall depth.
Low-weight supporting evidence.
Used only as a cross-check, not as a substitute for observed features.

global_rules.unknown_handling: Ignore unknown fields and renormalize available source weights.
global_rules.conflict_handling: If light and deep evidence are both strong, classify as medium unless one side exceeds the other by at least 18 points.

chroma_engine.purpose: Estimate whether the overall appearance is bright, clear, balanced, soft, or muted from observable skin, eyes, hair, lips, and feature definition before season scoring.

evidence_priority.reason: Eye clarity and iris definition are strong indicators of clear versus muted appearance.
Skin clarity and translucency support the overall chroma assessment.
Natural hair clarity and shine are useful when hair is not colored.
Feature definition helps separate bright or clear appearance from soft or muted appearance.
Natural lip clarity is low-weight supporting evidence.
Used only as a consistency check.

global_rules.unknown_handling: Ignore unknown fields and renormalize available source weights.
global_rules.conflict_handling: If clear or bright evidence and soft or muted evidence are both strong, classify as balanced unless one side exceeds the other by at least 15 points.

terminology_rule.bright: highest visible chroma and strongest visual impact
terminology_rule.clear: clean, fresh, defined chroma without necessarily extreme intensity
terminology_rule.balanced: neither distinctly bright nor distinctly muted
terminology_rule.muted: clearly greyed, smoky, dusty, or subdued appearance

contrast_engine.purpose: Estimate the overall visual contrast of appearance from skin, hair, eyes, eyebrows, and feature definition before season scoring.

evidence_priority.reason: Primary structural contrast of the face.
Important secondary contrast signal.
Captures whether features appear blended or sharply separated.
Supports the overall contrast estimate.
Supports visible eye definition.
Used only as a consistency check.

global_rules.unknown_handling: Ignore unknown fields and renormalize available source weights.
global_rules.conflict_handling: If low and high contrast evidence are both strong, classify as medium unless one side exceeds the other by at least 18 points.

exclusion_rules.purpose: Apply strong contradictions and hard incompatibilities after the four base engines have produced temperature, value, chroma, and contrast classifications.

hard_exclusion_requires: one very strong contradiction with confidence >= 0.75
or two independent strong contradictions with confidence >= 0.60
soft_penalty_requires: or one strong contradiction with insufficient confidence for hard exclusion

hard_exclusions.reason: Deep overall value contradicts the defining lightness of Light Spring.
Clearly cool temperature contradicts Light Spring.

strong_penalties.reason: Strongly muted appearance conflicts with Light Spring clarity.
High contrast conflicts with Light Spring's low-to-medium contrast.

hard_exclusions.reason: Clearly cool appearance contradicts True Spring.

strong_penalties.reason: Muted appearance conflicts with True Spring clarity.
Deep value is atypical for True Spring.

hard_exclusions.reason: Clearly cool temperature contradicts Bright Spring.

strong_penalties.reason: Low contrast conflicts with Bright Spring.
Deep value weakens Bright Spring.

hard_exclusions.reason: Deep overall value contradicts Light Summer.
Clearly warm appearance contradicts Light Summer.

strong_penalties.reason: Very bright chroma conflicts with Light Summer softness.
High contrast conflicts with Light Summer.

hard_exclusions.reason: Clearly warm appearance contradicts True Summer.

strong_penalties.reason: Bright chroma conflicts with True Summer softness.
High contrast is atypical for True Summer.
Clearly warm direction conflicts with Soft Summer.
High contrast conflicts with Soft Summer.
Deep value weakens Soft Summer.
Clearly cool direction conflicts with Soft Autumn.
High contrast conflicts with Soft Autumn.

hard_exclusions.reason: Clearly cool appearance contradicts True Autumn.

strong_penalties.reason: Very bright chroma is atypical for True Autumn.
Light value weakens True Autumn.
Clearly cool direction conflicts with Deep Autumn.
Low contrast is atypical for Deep Autumn.

hard_exclusions.reason: Clearly warm appearance contradicts Bright Winter.

strong_penalties.reason: Low contrast conflicts with Bright Winter.

hard_exclusions.reason: Clearly warm appearance contradicts True Winter.

strong_penalties.reason: Muted appearance conflicts with True Winter.
Clearly warm direction conflicts with Deep Winter.
Low contrast conflicts with Deep Winter.

cross_dimension_rules.reason: Light appearance with high contrast usually points away from the Light seasons.
Deep coloring without strong contrast weakens Deep and Winter outcomes.
Neutral temperature plus muted chroma strongly supports Soft seasons.
Clear high-contrast appearance supports Bright or Winter families.

execution_pipeline.purpose: Define the exact deterministic sequence from extracted features to final season ranking.

steps.action: Calculate warm, cool and neutral scores, classification and confidence.
Calculate light, medium and deep scores, classification and confidence.
Calculate bright, clear, balanced, soft and muted scores, classification and confidence.
Calculate low, medium and high scores, classification and confidence.
Compare four dimension classifications with all 12 season profiles.
Apply boosts and penalties from cross-dimension combinations.
Apply season-specific penalties and hard exclusions.
Run specific or generic confusion resolution for close top candidates.
Select best, second and third matches and calculate final confidence.

scoring_algorithm.unknown_dimension_rule: Ignore unknown or low-confidence dimensions and renormalize the remaining available dimensions.

exclusions.soft_penalty_application: add penalty to base score and clamp to 0..100

confidence_engine.dimension_confidence: Weighted mean of temperature, value, chroma and contrast engine confidences.

validation_rules: Every feature section must include confidence.
Unknown is allowed where the photo does not support a reliable observation.
Do not replace unknown with a guess.
Do not provide a final season in the input.

limitations: Weights and thresholds are not yet empirically calibrated.

pass_conditions.confusion_pair_cases: Expected side of the pair must rank first.
pass_conditions.missing_dimension_case: One of the allowed Light seasons must rank first without high confidence.
pass_conditions.insufficient_case: No season selected and better photo requested.

feature_execution.purpose: Calculate temperature, value, chroma and contrast directly from the strict feature JSON before running the season scoring pipeline.
feature_execution.fallback_policy: Use unknown rather than guessing when evidence is insufficient.

issues_fixed: Bright profiles could be classified as clear when clear_score exceeded bright_score despite strong bright markers.
Mixed light-skin/deep-hair profiles could return uncertain value instead of medium overall value.

value_mixed_extremes_rule.reason: The overall appearance contains both light and deep features, producing a medium composite value.
